state_and_ABI_limits.mode: Decode is x86-32 only. Current execution mode, segment descriptors, mappings, permissions, register values and memory values are unestablished.
state_and_ABI_limits.stack: Renew current SS.B=1 independently for every PUSH, CALL, POP and RET. Under that predicate and normal successful completion, PUSH and near CALL decrement current ESP by four and write through current SS; CALL stores its encoded return offset. POP and near RET read through current SS at current ESP and increment current ESP by four. No aggregate stack delta, balance or caller-return identity is inferred.
state_and_ABI_limits.source_order: PUSH dword [ESP+8] at C0503C forms its explicit source offset from pre-instruction current ESP and reads through current SS before its own stack decrement/write. The later store at C05042 and load at C05046 each form current ESP+8 anew; a returned opaque call separates the PUSH source from that store.
state_and_ABI_limits.segments_aliasing: Absolute cells and EAX+1FC use current DS; explicit ESP+8 operands default to current SS. Every implicit stack access uses current SS under its renewed stack-address predicate. No flat DS=SS assumption or non-alias property is established. Earlier stack writes can alias later cell reads through the current mappings.
state_and_ABI_limits.opaque_calls: The six computed targets and the C04EFB direct callee are not queried. If any opaque call returns, treat all returned registers, flags, memory and segment state as unknown. In particular ESI at C05002 is not assumed preserved from the earlier MOV or CALL, and either CALL EAX uses its own current EAX.
state_and_ABI_limits.literals: D69FD0 and D69FE0 are encoded immediate values only; their referents are unread. E15B00, E15AFC, CE20BC, CE215C and CE20F4 are numeric explicit memory offsets, without imported API, string, provider, pointer-value or library authentication.
state_and_ABI_limits.flags: TEST computes the bitwise conjunction for flags without storing a result: normal CF/OF reset, SF/ZF/PF set from the result, AF undefined. CMP EAX,-1 uses the sign-extended imm8 and updates subtraction flags without writing EAX. JE tests current ZF; the six adjacent comparisons support conditional local composition only on uninterrupted normal execution.
state_and_ABI_limits.control: Relative target arithmetic is a numeric code-offset fact. Computed CALL targets are unknown current register or memory values. RET C3 at C0504B has no encoded immediate adjustment, no ordinary sequential fallthrough, and an unknown current stack target. Reachability and return are not guaranteed.
state_and_ABI_limits.identity: Saved BSP_CRT_DecodePointerCurrentState/no_return=false/nonthunk and automatic call companions remain metadata. No function prototype, calling convention, decoded-pointer meaning, provider, library identity or callee-saved contract is recovered.
state_and_ABI_limits.boundary: C0504C, every callee/target body, every data-cell value and every immediate referent remain unqueried.
